title: Visual brief
description: One page from a chosen territory: the territory, its line, up to three reference frames, the proposition, the tone, what must show and what must never show. Approved once by the creative director, and then locked.

territory.description: The territory this page takes forward.

line.description: One sentence that says the territory.

source.description: typed: written by hand. territories: made by the Territories tool.

proposition.description: The brief's single-minded proposition, lifted at spin-off.

tone.description: The brief's tone and world, lifted at spin-off.

must_show.description: What every image must show (the Production Recipes name for product and brand rules).

reference_frames.description: Up to three uploaded images, in slots a, b and c. Phase 1 has no generated frames.

asset.description: The asset's name in the document.
